title: Dua Karo Amma
body:
Dua Karo Amma
Madina chhod chala, aaj mohd ka nawasa
<<MINI>>
Dua karo amma, dua karo nana..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Waade nibhaye saare..(2)
Pardes jaane wale

Lahu se apne sajaunga karbala ki zamee

Kardunga ghar ka ghar mai..(2)
Khud maut ke hawale

<<DIVIDER>>
Tamaam ambiya royenge dekhkar manzar

Dua karo amma, dua karo nana..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zamana kehta hai baba ko saqiye kausar To kyu na pyaas bujha du mai karbala jaakar

Amma wo shaam wale

Ye zulm dekhna ae amma karbala aake

Hojayenge ujale

<<DIVIDER>>
Na kaatle ye laee aakar bezabaan ka sar

<<DIVIDER>>
Banake turbat-e-asghar jo ran se aaunga

Pardesiyo ke naale

<<DIVIDER>>
Jo chhut ke shaam ke zindaa se aaenge qaidi
Tumhe sunaenge roro kar daasta apni
